notes: Instrumented captures are diagnostic evidence, not comparable timing benchmarks.
GC overlap is the union of main-thread V8.GC*, MinorGC, and MajorGC trace intervals inside each marked operation; nested intervals are not double-counted.
Incremental marking must be included: counting only MinorGC/MajorGC misses the slow hover capture.
CPU sampling and per-event tracing add overhead. Negative CPU-profiler deltas occurred in hover captures, so no weighted CPU percentages are reported for them.
The temporary diagnostic script and full CPU/trace files remain local; the compact trace windows are preserved here.
